Subject: Pilot extension
Date: Monday 12 October 2026
From: Dom Selvon <dom@valliance.ai>
To: Ravi Khatri <ravi.khatri@calderhealth.example.test>

Ravi,

Following the programme board, I will send the extension paper on Wednesday with the costs for the third ward.

You mentioned you would confirm the ward manager sign-off by Thursday. That is the only dependency I have on you.

Best,
Dom
